description: NPN low-side switch: the 3.3 V logic input on J_IN drives Q1's base through R_BASE (10 kOhm); Q1 sinks the LED current from VCC through R_LED (220 Ohm) and D1 to GND.
assumptions: Regulated 5 V supply on J_POWER (positive = +5 V, negative = GND), wired by hand.
The 3.3 V logic signal arrives on J_IN (positive = logic signal, negative = ground) and shares GND with the 5 V supply.
The kit has no S8050; the user accepted the kit's transistor_npn_generic. Generic part: verify the actual package pin order before building (an S8050 in TO-92 is usually E-B-C).
No LED colour was given; the user chose red. LED current is about (5 - 2 - 0.2) V / 220 Ohm = 13 mA; base current about (3.3 - 0.7) V / 10 kOhm = 0.26 mA.
Default _gap_0 variants for the resistors and the LED (leads in adjacent holes).
